introductoryCutscene.text: Initialized dialogue extension./p Press Z to continue./eWelcome-/l to Exelsior's World./eBut you may be wondering, just what kind of world is this?/eSome may call it ugly, or wrong, or cruel./p./p./l however.../eThe ruler of this world would beg to differ. They say these opinions are void, that their world is objectively perfect as is./eMany say beauty is in the eye of the beholder, but can the beholder alter the meaning of beauty?/eThat is for you to decide,/p in due time./l For now./p./p./eYou must work./e/!00

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc00Interact00.text: My bed./p Not very comfortable, but it serves its purpose./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc00Interact01.text: Behind the bars is a wide hallway./p How long it goes, I could never say./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc00Interact011.text: I've never been outside this room before./l Well,/p at least not while I'm conscious./eApparently every now and then they take us out for health inspection and cleaning while we sleep./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc00Interact02.text: Personal belongings, such as some clothes and fidgets./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc00Interact03.text: Food comes from here./p Sometimes I'll also get new clothes./eI'm pretty hungry, but it seems as if they're short on food for today./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc00Interact04.text: I don't need to go right now./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc00Interact05.text: I probably need to be at work soon./p./p. Time to put this thing on./l Again./e/!01

sc00Interact051.text: Almost on command,/p the machinery begins to wake up./lAnd,/p through the headset, you begin to make out a familiar setting./e/!02

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc01Cutscene.text: Gee, my head hurts.../eI'll try to log off early today, I suppose./l But here we are./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc01Interact00.text: I could change my appearance with this box if I wanted, but there's not much point./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc01Interact01.text: There's some games on this thing, I guess./eMaybe if I feel a bit better later today I'll entertain them, /pbut for now I need to get to work!

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc01Interact02.text: Some assorted gadgets./l Not much use since work gives me all the tools I'd ever need./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc02Interact00.text: Sometimes my boss is on here talking about some hip new joint in the city./l Or a global catastrophe./e

speaker: OPERATOR0040
sc02Interact01.text: This piece insults me./p I would do anything to sit down on this thing for real./e

axePickup00.text: Picked up a handaxe./p You might as well need the protection./e

speaker: Iris
axePickup01.text: I'm ending this one way or another./l It won't keep me in a cell EVER again!/e

speaker: Iris
elevator.text: Looks like one of the lifts at work. /pI wonder if-/p oh!/eUhm../eGeez, this place is huge. /pOnly one place the boss could be, though-/l 'Control Room'.../eOkay, let's do this./e/!98

ending0.text: Welcome back, OPERATORs!/eYou've done some impressive work today./p You may now rest for the day.../p to ensure you've got enough energy for tomorrow!/e/sHey, 40, what's up? Is your facial scanner acting up or something?/e/sH-huh? No, I'm fine, just./p./p./eI saw something REALLY weird while working today./p Something /punnatural./l And when I tried to approach it-/c/sOPERATOR40, is something the matter?/eFrom what it seems, you shouldn't have encountered anything out of the ordinary./eSome anomalies exist deep in the program,/p sure,/p but you weren't even CLOSE to the edge, believe me!/eI was just retrieving you to remind you your shift had ended!/p Now go along now, you seem a bit irate today!/e/sBut I swear there was an anomaly,/p why'd you-/c/sOPERATORS-/l DISMISSED!/eAnd so she couldn't discover what was behind that portal./l But maybe with a bit more dexterity.../eNah, not gonna happen./e/!99

speaker: Exelsior
ending1.text: You decide that venturing out is not worth the risk,/p and you put your headset back on./e/sGood.../l Thank you for complying with your rightful ADMINISTRATOR./eTake a deep breath now, this is all just a dream./!e1/p./p./e/sSo life returned to normal for Iris./p Or rather, for OPERATOR0040./eThe ADMINISTRATOR never questioned what happened, and Iris would encounter similar portals in following months./eShe never tried to enter one again,/p for she believed only trouble lurked beyond the normally barred-off door of her cell./eShe would pretend the portals didn't exist, but one day./p./p./l they disappeared for real./eAnd Iris would serve as an OPERATOR for the rest of her life, in blissful simplicity./e/!99

ending2.text: Iris had heard many differing stories about the world outside, none of them very positive./eIs the world coated in endless jungle?/p Wasteland?/p Ocean?/p Or was there no world at all?/eFor all she knew she could step outside and be evaporated in an instant./eBut that didn't happen./l Iris looked around her new surroundings, then at the massive facility behind her./l Only one thing was certain./eAs much as she would miss her family and coworkers, she could never go back./e/!99

ending3.text: So you're finally up./p Indeed, it never intended to kill you./eYou now have a new cell,/p a new job,/p and new furniture./eYour new room also has backup generators, so it's not like you'll be able to strut around like that again./eYour new job is to get rid of anomalies like what you saw./p So more don't get into trouble./eAfter that,/l you may rot alone./e It is what you deserve./e/!99

speaker: Iris
ending4.text: Destroying the central server released everyone from the simulation and their cells immediately./eSeeing this, I went back downstairs to find my family and friends./eWhen some of the others realized what I had done, they either turned away in confliction,/p or expressed gratitude./eSome decided to leave the facility and venture into the unknown./eBut not my family./l They resolved to stay by my side, no matter what./eAnd we have a lot of work ahead of us./eWe're going to make this place truly better for all of us./e/!99
